name: PBQ and a Little Eggstra Oxford 2024
information:
This competition only features quiet events and Clock. This competition is not recommended for first-timers or for those looking for a typical competition experience. Please consider instead any of the [many other competitions happening in Ohio](https://worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=all&search=ohio&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&display=list). 


Only one guest per competitor is permitted. Please consider coming without a guest as spectator seating will be limited.

You can find out about upcoming competitions in our area in our local Facebook group: [Ohio and Michigan Speedcubing](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1655301714974534/)
